entities.name: Émile Paul Amable Guépratte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Émile Paul Aimable Guépratte was a French admiral who served during World War I. After the war he became active in politics, serving as a deputy in the National Assembly for Finistère from 1919 to 1924. He was made a Grand Cross of the Legion of Honour in 1924.

entities.summary: Émile Paul Aimable Guépratte was a French admiral who served during World War I. After the war he became active in politics, serving as a deputy in the National Assembly for Finistère from 1919 to 1924. He was made a Grand Cross of the Legion of Honour in 1924.
